engine.title: Glossary: Activation, Note, Part, Resource, Add-on, Recharge, Variant, Scaling and Manual Effect
engine.body: Fold the glossary wording the map's tickets proposed into `CONTEXT.md`, and rename code and UI copy from "component" to "Part" where the glossary now says Part. Wording: the resolution comments on #250, #249, #255, #247, #252, #248 and #251.

engine.title: One kind, one place: move every Effect kind to its own definition
engine.body: As decided in #255: each kind in its own Go file with its field description, decode and checks, rules text and play capabilities; a lookup table of kinds in place of the shared check constraint; timestamped migrations that may run out of order; a generic recursive Part in the API with definitions served to the builder; the builder form generated from the definition; Scaling replaced by many rules or tables per Effect over scalable fields, with level formulas (#251). The first pull request proves the play direction on three real kinds in a real Session test before the rest move.

engine.title: Design files: load them into the database and check them in CI
engine.body: The reader from #241 for real: strict YAML under `api/db/designs/srd-2024/`, every check it showed failing, and loading into the Effect tables as #242 decides. Includes the per-kind `_no-effect.yaml` lists.

engine.title: Proof harness: fact check, review stamps, pattern registry and coverage ratchet
engine.body: The five layers decided in #245: the reader (from the loader), the mechanical fact check with `set_aside` and facts declared by each kind, review stamps checked by CI, a pattern registry with one file per pattern and a scenario test each, and the coverage ratchet against the base branch that turns strict per finished kind.

engine.title: Importer: read Recharge, uses per day, legendary cost and per-slot casting options; apply correction files
engine.body: As decided in #253: read `usage_limits`, `legendary_action_cost` and `casting_options`; apply one correction file per entry from `api/db/seeds/corrections/` when the snapshot is built, including whole added entries; a snapshot refresh flow that reports changes and flags corrections upstream now matches; a coverage page of upstream reports for the maintainer to file.

engine.title: Activation: chosen-target Targeting, cost, initial save or attack, duration
engine.body: As decided in #250 and #247: one Activation path for every owner; legal targets only (count, range, side, creature type, the caster's own Senses, willing for the same side), illegal targets blocked with the reason and a logged DM override; cost (slot, action economy including the SRD 5.2 Magic and Utilize actions, Material Components); the initial save or attack with the DC forms `spell`, `ability` and `fixed`; duration and concentration; Scaling applied before targeting; Add-ons offered in the step; applying by hand becomes a DM tool that never counts as full.

engine.title: Feature link: derived passive Effects, Feature Resources, Choice pools, granted spells
engine.body: As decided in #247.

engine.title: Item link: derived item Effects, Resources on Item Instances, variants, enforced hidden curses
engine.body: As decided in #248, including the migration of today's Charges.

engine.title: Monster link: derived traits, Combatant Resources, Recharge, the legendary prompt and the lair switch
engine.body: As decided in #252.

engine.title: Note Part and amounts read from the bearer
engine.body: The Note Part with its reason from the approved untracked domains (#249, list kept under `docs/rules/`), and values read from the bearer (ability modifier, Proficiency Bonus, class level, a Scale) on the kinds that take a number today.

engine.title: Audit the thirty existing kinds against play, and author the seeded Effects again as Design files
engine.body: As decided in #243: check each existing kind against play, fold its fixes into the matching family, and replace the twenty seeded Effects with Design files that pass the harness.

engine.title: Suggested Actions know Recharge, area actions and Multiattack
engine.body: As decided in #252: use a Recharge or area action when it would hit two or more foes the monster sees; prefer Multiattack over a single attack; otherwise today's Simple or Cunning rule; observed information only.
